title: Midnight nudge queue — rapid outreach checklist
content:
Goal: quick wins from small/time-zone accounts. 30–45 min focused push, then sync notes to CRM.

Metric targets tonight:
- 10 dials (aim for 5 conversations)
- 4 voicemails left with CTA
- 3 warm follow-up emails queued (Bcc myself)
- 1 calendar set or next-step commitment

Priority cohorts (order):
1) EMEA trialers who opened pricing last 72h — 8 accounts
2) APAC sandbox signups — low touch; try quick intros
3) US mid-market demo no-shows (resurface value props)

Quick call list (sketch — pull final CSV before dialing):
- Coda Labs (CTO: Ravi) — trial, 2 seats, notes: latency concerns, trial uses embeddings heavily
- Greenframe Analytics (Ops lead: Lena) — security question on VPC, good fit for Dedicated
- ParcelRex (Head of PM: Omar) — demo no-show, high token volume expected
- BlueArc Health (DevEng: Simone) — regulatory, needs private deployment info
- QuantileOps (SRE: Mark) — interested in batching and cost control

Voicemail script A (short, high-urgency):
"Hey [Name], Ivy from Redwood Inference — noticed your trial is active and you hit the pricing page. Quick question: are you blocked by latency or security? I can share a 5-min note on options now. Call me back at (415) 555-01xx or reply to this thread. Thanks."

Voicemail script B (value + micro-ask):
"Hi [Name], Ivy at Redwood — we helped a customer cut inference cost ~40% with batching + cache config, thought it might help your trial. Mind if I send one short note? 415-555-01xx."

Two-line email templates to queue:
- Subject: Short note on trial costs (30s)
  Body: "Hey [First], quick data point: customers similar to you drop token spend 25–40% with simple batching config. Would you like a 10-min tweak session this week? — Ivy"

- Subject: VPC/private deployment details
  Body: "[First], quick link: we have a one-pager on Private deployments and audit logs (attached). Happy to connect with your security lead for 15 minutes — when works?"

Call play notes (personal hacks):
- If prospect mentions "latency" -> pull benchmark for comparable model + region and DM to lead in convo.
- If "cost" -> mention Redwood Optimize: batching + quantization analysis offer. Offer quick sample calc (estimate tokens * current price * 0.6).
- For regulatory mentions -> triage to Private offering and loop Solutions Eng with tag "private-triage". Use template: "Looping in [SE] to cover compliance Qs; quick 15-min sync?"

Pipeline quick status (tonight):
- Hot (reply/intent): Coda Labs (call), ParcelRex (reschedule), BlueArc Health (intro to security)
- Warm (engaged): QuantileOps (demo scheduled), Greenframe (request for SOW)
- Cold: rest of sandbox signups

To do after shift:
- Update CRM notes (short bullet per account)
- Drop follow-up emails queued into Outreach sequences (tag: midnight-nudge)
- Create two simple benchmark screenshots for Coda and QuantileOps (attach to CRM)
- Add any compliance asks to ticket INF-842 (linked above)

Open questions / experiment ideas:
- A/B voicemail length: does adding a single sentence about % cost savings increase callbacks? Track over next 5 days.
- Best time for EMEA CTAs — try 22:00 PT vs 02:00 PT split.

Random nudge notes (brain dump):
- If I get a live convo and they ask ROI: have quick calc sheet URL (local copy) with tokens/day * projected price / 30 * 0.6 delta.
- Keep 'handoff to SE' messages <3 bullets. SEs hate long threads.

End-of-shift quick log (fill before logging off):
- Dials: ___  Conv: ___  VMs: ___  Emails queued: ___  Meetings: ___
- Quick wins: _______________________________
- Follow-up priority tomorrow: __________________

Notes to self: stop over-explaining product on first call; ask one problem question, then propose one micro-step.

-- Ivy
